name: Crittenden Estate Villas
signature: Self-contained vineyard villas on the Crittenden lake  -  wake up, walk to the cellar door, and eat at the on-estate Crittenden Restaurant
editorNote:
Crittenden's lakeside villas are the most unfussed winery stay on the Peninsula and arguably the most complete one-location weekend. Each villa is self-contained  -  kitchen, fireplace, private terrace on the lake  -  and the layout of the estate means the cellar door and the tasting rooms are all a two-minute walk from your front door.

Note: Stillwater at Crittenden is permanently closed. The on-estate restaurant is now Crittenden Restaurant under Head Chef Brunno Melo, operating daily lunch and Friday to Saturday dinner. The villas are unaffected by the change, but if you made a booking on the basis of dining at Stillwater, confirm the current restaurant offering directly.

Book for a Sunday-to-Tuesday stay to avoid the weekend wedding schedule. Order the Los Hermanos tasting on arrival and work through the Nebbiolo at the restaurant.
